annotations.title: Send a quote request to Susman Insurance Agency

description: Sends a person's answers to Susman Insurance Agency as a quote request. It is meant for a real person who has confirmed the answers, with their real name and email. A licensed agent reviews each request and follows up by phone or email, and the person receives an email receipt. If required questions are missing, the result lists them. Limits: 10 requests per hour per network address, 3 per day per person.

agent.description: Optional: the assistant or product sending this.

answers.description: Keyed by the form's question names. Choice questions take the choice text; checkbox questions take an array; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

consent.description: Must be true: the person authorised you to send this request for them.
